governing_rule: A foreclosure timeline is a chain of different legal events, not one deadline. Verification and applicability are separate questions.

authorities.supports: For covered mortgages/deeds of trust and covered entities, NOD recording is restricted until 30 days after required borrower contact or satisfaction of statutory due diligence; NOD includes a compliance declaration.

Nonjudicial foreclosure sequence: record NOD; not less than three months elapse; sale notice follows §2924f; sale may not be earlier than three months and 20 days after NOD when early sale-notice recording rule is used; written notice after qualifying postponement.

Statutory reinstatement may cure specified defaults without paying principal that would not otherwise be due; statutory notice describes reinstatement as normally available until five business days before sale, subject to the statute and loan terms.
Notice-of-sale mailing/posting/publication requirements and minimum notice period; final subsection-level audit remains required before publication of every service detail.
Trustee-sale postponement mechanics; final subsection-level audit remains required before publication of all oral/public announcement rules.

default_servicing_problem.label: DEFAULT / SERVICING PROBLEM

clock.display: For loans and entities covered by §2923.5, a notice of default may not be recorded until 30 days after the required initial contact or after statutory due diligence is satisfied, subject to the statute's coverage limits and loss-mitigation provisions.

warnings: Do not infer that a violation automatically voids a foreclosure sale.
California procedure and federal Regulation X are separate layers.

notice_of_default.label: NOTICE OF DEFAULT

clock.display: Civil Code §2924 requires not less than three months to elapse after the notice of default is recorded before the sale-notice stage described by the statute.

other_clocks.display: When the notice of sale is recorded under §2924(a)(4)'s early-recording rule, the sale date may be no earlier than three months and 20 days after the NOD recording.

warnings: This is not a generic promise that every homeowner has exactly 90 days.
Use the recorded NOD date, not the date a borrower happened to read it.

reinstatement.label: REINSTATEMENT

clock.display: Section 2924c's statutory notice describes reinstatement as normally available until five business days before the scheduled sale, subject to statutory and loan-specific conditions.

warnings: Reinstatement is not redemption.
Reinstatement is not a guaranteed loan modification.
After the statutory reinstatement period, other payoff or written-agreement rights may differ.

notice_of_trustees_sale.label: NOTICE OF TRUSTEE'S SALE
warnings: Do not publish a bare sale-notice number until §2924f mailing/posting/publication details and exact trigger are fully audited.
NOD timing and trustee-sale notice timing are different legal events.

sale_postponed.label: FORECLOSURE SALE POSTPONED / NEW DATE

clock.display: When a sale is postponed for at least 10 business days under §2924g, §2924(a)(5) requires written notice to the borrower of the new sale date and time within five business days after postponement; failure to provide that notice does not itself invalidate an otherwise valid sale.

warnings: Do not rely only on the original sale date.
The public-declaration mechanics under §2924g require separate final audit.

trustee_sale_completed.label: TRUSTEE SALE ALREADY HAPPENED
warnings: A completed sale is not a promise that title can be reversed.
Sale does not itself equal immediate physical eviction; possession procedure is separate.

post_sale_possession.label: POST-SALE POSSESSION
warnings: Foreclosure title procedure and unlawful-detainer possession procedure are separate.
Former-owner and tenant occupancy can require different analysis.

hoa_foreclosure.label: HOA FORECLOSURE
warnings: Do not reuse mortgage-foreclosure deadlines.

tax_foreclosure.label: TAX FORECLOSURE
warnings: Unknown means not verified, not no deadline.

court_foreclosure_paper.label: COURT / JUDICIAL FORECLOSURE PAPER
warnings: Route immediately to legal help until procedure is verified.

va_home_loan_default.label: VA-GUARANTEED HOME LOAN IN DEFAULT
warnings: VA usually guarantees rather than owns or services the loan.
VA assistance does not automatically halt California foreclosure.

priority_questions: Are you currently in qualifying military service?
Do you have a foreclosure sale date?
Have you submitted a loss-mitigation application?
publication_limits: No unverified deadline renders as actionable legal advice.
Regulation X and SCRA remain federal overlays, not California authority.
VA guaranty is not ownership or servicing.
HOA and tax foreclosure remain separate and null-safe until verified.
